rust_summary: a toast of a mod's own in the advancement toasts' slots (`native_add_toast`).
doc_summary: `native_add_toast(id, icon, title, description, challenge)` (client, `host.add_toast`) queues a toast of the mod's own in the slots the advancement toasts use, drawn as an `AdvancementToast`: the item `icon`, `title` in the frame label's place (yellow, or pink with the challenge sound when `challenge`) and `description` as its white line. `native_toast_add` hears it first as kind `mod` with the mod's `id`. False on a server, without a window and when cancelled. Bundles need "hooks": @API:add_toast@.
